observations: Photo 0: Used car engine with transmission attached, standing upright on wooden pallets outdoors. Many hoses, wiring, and connectors visible, covered in dirt/grime. Blue strap wrapped around part of the assembly. Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC.'
Photo 1: Same engine/transmission unit shown from a slightly different angle, surrounded by other used engines in a yard. A person partially visible in background. Same watermark present.

Photo 2: Close-up of the transmission end of the unit lying on the ground, showing housing, hoses, and connectors caked with dirt and dried debris. A person's legs and sandals visible nearby for scale.

identity.kind: used car engine with transmission (engine-gearbox assembly)

not_shown: Engine displacement, cylinder count, fuel type
Whether engine runs/starts, compression test results
Condition of internal components (pistons, bearings, timing belt/chain)
Presence of all sensors/accessories (alternator, starter, turbo if any)
Any fluid leaks (oil, coolant, transmission fluid)
Whether wiring harness and ECU are included and functional
